en.t: Julian leaves Antioch on campaign against the Sasanians
en.s: On March 5, 363, Roman Emperor Julian left Antioch to begin his campaign against the Sasanian Empire.
en.n: Antioch is the ancient city at the site of modern Antakya, Turkey.

zh.t: 尤利安离开安条克，出征萨珊帝国
zh.s: 公元363年3月5日，罗马皇帝尤利安离开安条克，出征萨珊帝国。
zh.n: 安条克位于今天土耳其的安塔基亚。

en.s: The Battle of Aizkraukle or Ascheraden was a battle fought on March 5, 1279, between the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, led by Traidenis, and the Livonian branch of the Teutonic Order near Aizkraukle (German: Ascheraden) in present-day Latvia. The order suffered a great defeat: 71 knights, including the grand master, Ernst von Rassburg, and Eilart Hoberg, leader of the knights from Danish Estonia, were killed. It was the second-largest defeat of the order in the 13th century. After this battle Duke Nameisis of the Semigallians recognized Traidenis as his suzerain.

zh.s: 1279年3月5日，特莱德尼斯率立陶宛大公国军队，与条顿骑士团利沃尼亚分支，在今拉脱维亚艾兹克劳克莱附近交战，德文也称阿舍拉登战役。骑士团遭到惨败，71名骑士阵亡，包括大团长恩斯特·冯·拉斯堡，以及丹属爱沙尼亚骑士首领艾拉尔特·霍贝格。这是该骑士团13世纪第二严重的失败。战后，瑟米加利亚公爵纳梅西斯承认特莱德尼斯为宗主。

en.s: The Battle of Maes Moydog was a battle that took place at the field of Moydog (Welsh: Maidog, also Meidiog) on 5 March 1295 during the revolt of Madog ap Llywelyn and others against English rule, near the modern-day town of Llanfair Caereinion in Powys, Wales.

zh.s: 1295年3月5日，马多格·阿普·利韦林等人反抗英格兰统治期间，威尔士波伊斯今兰韦尔凯雷尼恩镇附近的莫伊多格田野发生战斗，史称迈斯莫伊多格战役。该地名也有迈多格、梅迪奥格等拼写。

en.s: The Battle of Mombasa took place on 5 March 1589, between Portuguese and Zimba forces under the command of Tomé Coutinho against the Ottomans. The Portuguese would reconquer the city and capture Mir Ali Beg.

zh.s: 1589年3月5日，葡萄牙军队与津巴人部队在托梅·库蒂纽指挥下对阵奥斯曼军队，双方在蒙巴萨交战。葡萄牙人后来重新夺回该城，并俘获米尔·阿里·贝格。

en.s: The Battle of Rakvere took place March 5, 1603 during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). In the battle the Lithuanians lost only one soldier, and two were wounded. The Swedes lost 70 Germans mercenaries and 100 Estonian peasants.

zh.s: 1603年3月5日，波兰—瑞典战争期间发生拉克韦雷战役。立陶宛军仅一名士兵阵亡、两人受伤；瑞典方面损失70名德国雇佣兵和100名爱沙尼亚农民。

en.t: The Index Congregation suspends Copernicus’s book pending correction
en.s: On 5 March 1616 in Rome, the Congregation of the Index prohibited books supporting heliocentrism and suspended Nicolaus Copernicus’s De revolutionibus orbium coelestium until it was corrected. First published in 1543 in Nuremberg, the book presented a heliocentric model of the universe as an alternative to Ptolemy’s geocentric model.
en.n: Copernicus’s book was suspended pending correction.

zh.t: 《天体运行论》被暂停流通，等待修订
zh.s: 1616年3月5日，罗马的禁书审查会下令禁止宣扬日心说的书籍，并暂停哥白尼《天体运行论》的流通，直至完成修订。这本书于1543年在纽伦堡首次出版，提出了不同于托勒密地心说的日心说宇宙模型。
zh.n: 命令对哥白尼这本书的处理是暂停流通、等待修订。

en.s: The Christianshavn Incident (Danish: Christianshavnhændelsen, Spanish: Christianopuerto Incidente), also known as the Skirmish at Santa Cruz (Danish: Træfningen ved Santa Cruz), was a minor incident and skirmish between Danish and Spanish military assets near Santa Cruz de Tenerife in Spain. The Danish vessel, Christianshavn, was badly wounded and the Danes had to retreat into harbour, where they would be detained.

zh.s: 克里斯蒂安港事件又称圣克鲁斯小冲突，是丹麦和西班牙军方在西班牙圣克鲁斯-德特内里费附近发生的一次小规模冲突。丹麦船“克里斯蒂安港”号严重受损，丹麦人被迫撤入港口，随后遭到扣押。

en.s: Henry Morgan's Panama expedition, also known as The Sack of Panama, was a military expedition in which English privateers commanded by Welsh Buccaneer Henry Morgan launched an attack with an army of 1,400 men (including French and Dutch volunteers) with the purpose of capturing the rich Spanish city of Panama off the Pacific coast between 16 December 1670 and 5 March 1671 during the later stage of the Anglo-Spanish War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 亨利·摩根的巴拿马远征
zh.s: 亨利·摩根的巴拿马远征又称“洗劫巴拿马”，是英西战争后期的一次军事行动。威尔士海盗亨利·摩根率领1400人（包括法国和荷兰志愿者）组成的军队，试图攻占太平洋沿岸富裕的西班牙城市巴拿马。远征从1670年12月16日持续至1671年3月5日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of St. John's was a failed attempt by French forces led by Daniel d'Auger de Subercase to take the fort at St. John's, Newfoundland during the winter months of 1705, in Queen Anne's War. Leading a mixed force of regulars, militia, and Indians, Subercase burned much of the town and laid an ineffectual siege against the fort for five weeks between late January and early March 1705.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1705年冬，丹尼尔·德奥热·德·苏贝尔卡斯率领法国军队，试图攻占纽芬兰圣约翰斯的要塞，但未能成功。这是安妮女王战争的一部分。苏贝尔卡斯率领正规军、民兵和原住民组成的混合部队，焚毁了城镇的大部分区域，并围攻要塞五周，时间从1月底持续到3月初。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Boston Massacre, known in Great Britain as the Incident on King Street, was a confrontation on March 5, 1770, in the prelude to the American Revolution in Boston, in what was then the colony of the Province of Massachusetts Bay. In the confrontation, nine British soldiers shot several in a crowd, estimated between 300 and 400, who were harassing them verbally and throwing various projectiles.

zh.s: 1770年3月5日，美国革命前夕，时属马萨诸塞湾殖民地的波士顿发生冲突，史称波士顿惨案，在英国也称国王街事件。九名英国士兵向一群人开枪，击中数人。现场人群估计有300至400人，此前不断辱骂士兵，并向他们投掷各种物品。

en.s: The Battle of Grauholz on 5 March 1798 was a battle between a Bernese army under Karl Ludwig von Erlach against the French Revolutionary Army under Balthazar Alexis Henri Schauenburg. The battle took place at Grauholz, a wooded hill in what is now the municipalities of Urtenen-Schönbühl and Moosseedorf in the canton of Bern in Switzerland. The government of Bern had already surrendered the previous day and the Bernese defeat at Grauholz ended their resistance to the French in the north of the canton.

zh.s: 1798年3月5日，卡尔·路德维希·冯·埃拉赫率伯尔尼军队，与巴尔塔扎尔·阿莱克西·亨利·绍恩堡指挥的法国革命军交战。战场位于格劳霍尔茨一座林木覆盖的山丘，今属瑞士伯尔尼州乌尔特嫩-申比尔及莫斯塞多夫。伯尔尼政府前一天已投降，此战失利也结束了该州北部对法军的抵抗。

en.s: The Castle Hill Rebellion of 1804 was a rebellion by convicts against colonial authority in the Castle Hill area of the British colony of New South Wales. The rebellion culminated in a battle fought between convicts and the Colonial forces of Australia on 5 March 1804 at Rouse Hill, dubbed the Second Battle of Vinegar Hill after the first one of 1798 Battle of Vinegar Hill in Ireland. It was the first and only major convict uprising in Australian history suppressed under martial law.

zh.s: 1804年，英国新南威尔士殖民地城堡山地区的囚犯，起义反抗殖民当局。3月5日，囚犯与澳大利亚殖民部队在劳斯山交战，事件达到高潮。这场战斗借用1798年爱尔兰醋山战役之名，被称为“第二次醋山战役”。这是澳大利亚历史上首次、也是唯一一次在军法管制下被镇压的大规模囚犯起义。

en.s: The Battle of Barrosa (Chiclana, 5 March 1811) was part of an unsuccessful manoeuvre to break the siege of Cádiz in Spain during the Peninsular War. During the battle, a single British division defeated two French divisions and captured a regimental eagle. Cádiz had been invested by the French in early 1810, leaving it accessible from the sea, but in March of the following year a reduction in the besieging army gave its garrison of British and Spanish troops an opportunity to lift the siege. A large Allied strike force was shipped south from Cádiz to Tarifa, and moved to engage the siege lines from the rear.

zh.s: 1811年3月5日，半岛战争期间，西班牙奇克拉纳附近发生巴罗萨战役，是一场未能成功解除加的斯围城的行动的一部分。一个英国师击败两个法国师，并夺得一面团鹰旗。法军于1810年初围困加的斯，但海路仍畅通。1811年3月围城法军减少，给英西守军提供解围机会。一支庞大的盟军突击部队从加的斯乘船南下塔里法，再转向围城阵线后方进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Berry-au-Bac was fought on 5 March 1814 at Berry-au-Bac, northern France, between French cavalry under the command of Emperor Napoleon and the Cossacks of Russian general Ferdinand von Wintzingerode. During the engagement, the French captured Berry-au-Bac's bridge over the Aisne and repulsed the Russian cavalry, allowing the rest of Napoleon's troops to cross the river.

zh.s: 1814年3月5日，拿破仑指挥的法国骑兵与俄军将领费迪南德·冯·温岑格罗德率领的哥萨克人在法国北部贝里欧巴克交战。法军夺取了该地跨越埃纳河的桥梁，并击退俄军骑兵，使拿破仑的其余部队得以渡河。

en.t: British India declares war on the Burmese Empire
en.s: On 5 March 1824, British India formally declared war on the Burmese Empire, beginning the First Anglo-Burmese War. Frontier clashes and territorial disputes had escalated into open war.
en.n: This entry records the declaration that began the First Anglo-Burmese War, not the full series of three Anglo-Burmese Wars from 1824 to 1885.

zh.t: 英属印度向缅甸王国宣战
zh.s: 1824年3月5日，英属印度正式向缅甸王国宣战，第一次英缅战争由此开始。边境冲突和领土争端不断升级，最终演变为公开战争。
zh.n: 本条记录的是第一次英缅战争开始时的宣战，不是1824年至1885年间三次英缅战争的全部历史。

en.s: A naval campaign carried out by an alliance between the Spanish Empire forces in Puerto Rico, the Danish government in Saint Thomas and the United States Navy captured Roberto Cofresí's pirate sloop Anne. The powers pursued Roberto Cofresí's pirate flotilla in March 1825 because of the economic losses suffered by the parties to the pirates, as well as diplomatic concerns caused by their use of the flags of Spain and Gran Colombia which menaced the fragile peace between the naval powers. Several of those involved had been attacked by the freebooters. Among the diplomatic concerns caused by Cofresí was a robbery carried out by several of his subordinates, the catalyst of an incident that threatened war between Spain and the United States known as "The Foxardo Affair", eventually leading to the resignation of his rival, pirate hunter David Porter. Sailing under the authorization of the Danish West Indies, the coalition employed two local ships, including a former victim of the pirates named San José y las Animas and USS Grampus of the West Indies Squadron. A ship from Gran Colombia, named La Invencible, also provided support during the initial stages. The final naval engagement took place on March 5, 1825, and began with a trap set at Boca del Infierno, a passage off Bahía de Jobos, Puerto Rico.

zh.t: 海盗单桅船“安妮”号被俘
zh.s: 1825年3月，西班牙驻波多黎各部队、丹麦圣托马斯当局及美国海军组成联盟，追捕罗伯托·科弗雷西的海盗船队，并俘获他的单桅船“安妮”号。海盗给各方造成经济损失，又使用西班牙及大哥伦比亚旗帜，引发外交问题，威胁海上列强之间脆弱的和平，参与追捕者中也有人曾遭其袭击。科弗雷西手下曾实施一起抢劫，触发险些引发西美战争的“法哈多事件”，最终导致其对手、缉盗军官戴维·波特辞职。在丹属西印度群岛许可下，联盟使用两艘本地船，包括曾遭海盗劫掠的“圣何塞与灵魂”号，以及西印度分舰队的美国“格兰普斯”号。大哥伦比亚的“无敌”号也在初期提供支援。最后一场海上交战于1825年3月5日发生，始于联军在波多黎各霍沃斯湾外“地狱之口”水道布下的圈套。

en.s: The Battle of Koronisia or Kyronisia was a military conflict of the Greek War of Independence with a victorious outcome for the Greeks.

zh.s: 科罗尼西亚战役（也称基罗尼西亚战役）是希腊独立战争期间的一场军事冲突，最终希腊方面获胜。

en.t: New Jersey charters the Patent Arms Manufacturing Company
en.s: On March 5, 1836, the New Jersey legislature chartered the Patent Arms Manufacturing Company of Paterson. Samuel Colt and his investors formed the company to manufacture his revolver. This was a corporate charter, following his U.S. patent on February 25.
en.n: The date marks the company charter, not the grant of the revolver patent or a documented first day of factory production.

zh.t: 新泽西州批准科尔特枪械公司的设立特许
zh.s: 1836年3月5日，美国新泽西州议会向帕特森专利枪械制造公司授予设立特许。塞缪尔·科尔特与投资者组建这家公司，用于生产他的转轮手枪。科尔特此前已于2月25日获得美国专利。
zh.n: 当天的事项是公司获准设立，并非手枪获授专利，也不能据此认定工厂当天开始生产。

en.s: The Cincomarzada was a failed Carlist attempt to conquer the city of Zaragoza on 5 March 1838. Nowadays it is a popular holiday in Zaragoza commemorating the heroic behaviour of the citizens during the First Carlist War.

zh.s: 1838年3月5日，卡洛斯派军队试图攻占萨拉戈萨，但未能成功。如今，萨拉戈萨每年举行“五三节”，纪念第一次卡洛斯战争期间市民的英勇表现。

en.s: The 1839 Chicago mayoral election saw Whig nominee Benjamin Wright Raymond defeat Democratic nominee James Curtiss by a landslide 25 point margin. The election was held on March 5.

zh.s: 1839年3月5日，芝加哥举行市长选举。辉格党候选人本杰明·赖特·雷蒙德以25个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·柯蒂斯。

en.s: The Second Battle of Szolnok took place during the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848–1849 on 5 March 1849. It was fought between the two divisions of the revolutionary Hungarian army led by Major-General János Damjanich and Major-General Károly Vécsey against the brigades of the Austrian Empire led by Major General Leopold Edler von Karger and General Ferenc Ottinger.

zh.s: 索尔诺克第二次战役发生于1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争期间，时间为1849年3月5日。匈牙利革命军的两个师由扬诺什·达姆亚尼奇少将和卡罗伊·韦切伊少将率领，对阵奥地利帝国军队。奥军由利奥波德·冯·卡格尔少将和费伦茨·奥廷格将军率领。

en.t: Robert Stephenson completes the Britannia Bridge
en.s: On March 5, 1850, Robert Stephenson fitted the final rivet in the Britannia Bridge across the Menai Strait in Wales, marking its official completion. Rail traffic began using a single tube on March 18; both tubes were open by October.
en.n: The completion ceremony preceded the opening to regular rail traffic.

zh.t: 罗伯特·斯蒂芬森完成布列塔尼亚桥的最后一道铆接
zh.s: 1850年3月5日，罗伯特·斯蒂芬森为横跨威尔士梅奈海峡的布列塔尼亚桥安装最后一枚铆钉，标志着大桥正式完工。3月18日，其中一条管状桥道开放铁路通行；到10月，两条桥道均已通车。
zh.n: 完工仪式早于铁路正式通车。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in France on 28 February 1857, with a second round on 5 March. According to the constitution of the empire, partisans of the regime ran as "official candidates" of the regime in often gerrymandered circonscriptions. As official candidates, their campaign expenditures were paid by the government and their campaigns were led by the local government.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国于1857年2月28日举行议会选举，第二轮投票在3月5日举行。根据帝国宪法，支持政权的候选人被列为“官方候选人”，参选选区往往经过不公正划分。官方候选人的竞选费用由政府承担，地方政府也负责领导其竞选活动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The Battle of Thompson's Station was a battle of the American Civil War, occurring on March 5, 1863 in Williamson County, Tennessee. In a period of relative inactivity following the Battle of Stones River, a reinforced Union infantry brigade, under Col. John Coburn, left Franklin to reconnoiter south toward Columbia. Four miles from Spring Hill, Coburn attacked with his right wing, a Confederate Army force composed of two regiments; he was repelled. Then, Maj. Gen. Earl Van Dorn seized the initiative. Brig. Gen. zh.s: 1863年3月5日，美国南北战争期间，田纳西州威廉森县发生汤普森车站战役。斯通斯河战役后，战线一度较为平静，约翰·科伯恩上校率一支得到加强的联邦步兵旅，从富兰克林南下侦察哥伦比亚方向。距斯普林希尔四英里处，他以右翼攻击两个团的邦联军，却被击退。随后厄尔·范多恩少将夺取主动，W.H.杰克逊准将，绰号“红发”，率下马作战的第二师正面进攻。原文在介绍另一名准将行动前中断。

en.s: The Battle of Yazoo City (March 5, 1864) was an engagement in Mississippi during a month-long Union expedition up the Yazoo River in the American Civil War. The Union force commanded by Colonel James H. Coates repulsed an attack led by Confederate Brigadier General Lawrence S. Ross. The Union force suffered greater losses and withdrew down the river the next day with a large amount of cotton seized or bought from plantations along the river.

zh.s: 1864年3月5日，美国南北战争期间，联邦军沿亚祖河进行为期一个月的远征，在密西西比州亚祖城与邦联军交战。詹姆斯·H.科茨上校指挥的联邦军，击退劳伦斯·S.罗斯准将率领的进攻。不过，联邦军损失更大，次日沿河撤退，带走大量从沿岸种植园没收或购买的棉花。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 20 February and 5 March 1876 to elect the members of the Chamber of Deputies, the lower chamber of the National Assembly. They were the first elections under the French Constitutional Laws of 1875. The result was a victory for the Republicans.

en.s: The 1891 Canadian federal election was held on March 5, 1891, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 7th Parliament of Canada. It was won by the Conservative Party of Prime Minister Sir John A. Macdonald. The main issue of the 1891 campaign was Macdonald's National Policy, a policy of protective tariffs. The Liberals supported reciprocity (free trade) with the United States.

en.s: The Battle of Jigjiga was fought on March 5, 1900, between the Ethiopian Empire and the Dervish State. The Dervishes, led by Sayyid Mohamed Hassan, stormed a military fort at the Somali city of Jigjiga in the Ogaden region with the objective of repossessing livestock looted from locals by an Abyssinian military expedition.

en.s: The Battle of Lonoy, also known as the Lonoy Massacre, was a surprise attack in 1901 during the Philippine–American War when over 400 Filipino revolutionaries were killed by United States Armed Forces. It was fought in Lonoy, Jagna, Bohol on Bohol island. Filipino forces laid an ambush along a narrow path. They were poorly armed, with daggers, machetes, and spears and few firearms.

zh.s: 洛诺伊战役又称洛诺伊屠杀，是1901年菲律宾—美国战争期间的一次突袭，400多名菲律宾革命者被美军杀害。战斗发生在保和岛的洛诺伊。菲律宾部队沿一条狭窄小路设伏，装备简陋，只有匕首、砍刀、长矛和少量枪支。

en.s: The First Battle of Bud Dajo, also known as the Moro Crater Massacre, was a counterinsurgency action conducted by the United States Army and Marine Corps against the Moro people in March 1906, during the Moro Rebellion in the southwestern Philippines. During the engagement, 750 men and officers, under the command of Colonel Joseph Wilson Duncan, assaulted the volcanic crater of Bud Dajo (Tausug: Būd Dahu), which was populated by 800 to 1,000 Tausūg villagers.
en.n: Moro Rebellion: United States Army troops bring overwhelming force against the native Moros in the First Battle of Bud Dajo, leaving only six survivors.

zh.s: 第一次布德达霍战役又称摩洛火山口屠杀，是1906年3月摩洛叛乱期间，美国陆军和海军陆战队针对菲律宾西南部摩洛人发动的一次平叛行动。约瑟夫·威尔逊·邓肯上校率领750名官兵，进攻布德达霍火山口。当地有800至1,000名陶苏格村民。
zh.n: 摩洛叛乱期间，美军在第一次布德达霍战役中以压倒性兵力进攻当地摩洛人，最终仅有6人幸存。

en.s: The Clonbanin ambush was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 5 March 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. It took place in the townland of Clonbanin (a.k.a. Cloonbannin), County Cork. The IRA force was under the command of Sean Moylan and comprised almost 100 volunteers from counties Cork and Kerry, armed with rifles, hand grenades and a machine gun.

en.s: The Coto War (Spanish: Guerra de Coto) was a conflict between Panama and Costa Rica fought between 21 February and 5 March 1921. The casus belli occurred when a Costa Rican expeditionary force led by Colonel Héctor Zúñiga Mora occupied the town of Pueblo Nuevo de Coto, a hamlet on the banks of the Coto River. At that time the hamlet was in the Alanje district of the Panamanian province of Chiriquí.

zh.s: 科托战争是巴拿马与哥斯达黎加在1921年2月21日至3月5日之间进行的冲突。导火索是埃克托尔·苏尼加·莫拉上校率哥斯达黎加远征军，占领科托河畔的科托新村。该村当时属于巴拿马奇里基省阿兰赫区。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 5 March 1933. The 1933 poll was held after the Nazi seizure of power and the Reichstag fire, just six days before the election. Nazi storm troopers had unleashed a campaign of violence against the Communist Party (KPD), left-wingers, trade unionists, the Social Democratic Party of Germany, and the centre-right Catholic Centre Party. The 1933 election followed the previous year's two elections (July and November) and Hitler's appointment as Chancellor. In the months before the 1933 election, brownshirts and SS displayed "terror, repression and propaganda [...] across the land", and Nazi organizations "monitored" the vote process.

zh.s: 德国于1933年3月5日举行国会选举，时间在纳粹夺权及国会纵火案之后，纵火距投票仅六天。纳粹冲锋队对共产党、左翼人士、工会成员、社会民主党及中右翼天主教中央党发动暴力打击。此前1932年7月和11月已举行两次选举，随后希特勒获任总理。1933年选举前数月，冲锋队与党卫军在全国实施恐吓、镇压及宣传，纳粹组织还“监督”投票过程。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 5 March 1933. The pro-monarchist People's Party emerged as the largest party, winning 118 of the 248 seats in Parliament, ending the predominance of Eleftherios Venizelos' Liberal Party. The results triggered an attempted coup by Venizelist officers. A military emergency government under Alexandros Othonaios was instituted which suppressed the revolt, and was succeeded by a People's Party cabinet under Panagis Tsaldaris on 10 March.

zh.s: 希腊于1933年3月5日举行议会选举。支持君主制的人民党在248席中赢得118席，成为第一大党，结束埃莱夫塞里奥斯·韦尼泽洛斯自由党的优势地位。结果引发韦尼泽洛斯派军官发动未遂政变。亚历山德罗斯·奥索奈奥斯组成紧急军政府平息叛乱，随后于3月10日由帕纳伊斯·察尔达里斯领导的人民党内阁接替。

en.s: The battle of Cape Machichaco was a naval battle which took place on 5 March 1937 off Bermeo, during the Spanish Civil War, between the Spanish Nationalist heavy cruiser Canarias and four Basque Navy trawlers escorting a Republican convoy. The trawlers were protecting the transport ship Galdames, which was sailing to Bilbao with 173 passengers.

zh.s: 1937年3月5日，西班牙内战期间，马奇查科角附近发生海战。西班牙国民军重巡洋舰“加那利群岛”号与四艘护送共和派船队的巴斯克海军拖网渔船交战。拖网渔船当时正护送运输船“加尔达梅斯”号前往毕尔巴鄂，船上载有173名乘客。

en.t: Casado’s coup establishes Spain’s National Defence Council
en.s: On March 5, 1939, Colonel Segismundo Casado and his allies seized power in Republican Spain and announced a National Defence Council in Madrid. They sought negotiations to end the Spanish Civil War, but Francisco Franco insisted on unconditional surrender.

zh.t: 卡萨多发动政变，成立西班牙国防委员会
zh.s: 1939年3月5日，塞吉斯蒙多·卡萨多上校及其盟友在西班牙共和派阵营夺权，并在马德里宣布成立国防委员会。他们希望通过谈判结束西班牙内战，但弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥坚持要求无条件投降。

en.t: Soviet Politburo approves the Katyn executions
en.s: On 5 March 1940 in Moscow, the Soviet Politburo approved Lavrentiy Beria’s proposal to execute 14,700 Polish prisoners of war and 11,000 people held in prisons in western Ukraine and Belarus. The executions began later, in April 1940.
en.n: This was the decision authorizing the killings; the executions took place later.

zh.t: 苏联政治局批准卡廷大屠杀处决计划
zh.s: 1940年3月5日，苏联政治局在莫斯科批准了拉夫连季·贝利亚提出的处决计划，涉及14,700名波兰战俘，以及关押在乌克兰西部和白俄罗斯西部监狱的11,000人。处决行动于同年4月开始。
zh.n: 这一天作出的是批准杀害这些人的决定，处决行动后来才开始。

en.s: The Battle of Leuwiliang was a battle during the Dutch East Indies campaign of the Pacific War that took place between 3 and 5 March 1942. Australian forces, supported by American artillery batteries and British tanks, launched a holding action starting at Leuwiliang, West Java, to cover the retreat of allied Dutch forces in the face of the Japanese invasion of Java.

zh.s: 勒维利昂战役发生于太平洋战争荷属东印度战役期间，时间为1942年3月3日至5日。澳大利亚军队在美军炮兵和英军坦克支援下，于西爪哇勒维利昂展开阻击，掩护盟军中的荷兰部队在日军入侵爪哇时撤退。

en.s: The Sutton Wick air crash occurred on 5 March 1957 when a Blackburn Beverley C Mk 1 heavy transport aircraft, serial number XH117, of 53 Squadron Royal Air Force crashed at Sutton Wick, Drayton, Berkshire, England, following shut-down of one engine and partial loss of power on another. After take-off, No. 1 engine was shut down as a precautionary measure and whilst on final approach back to RAF Abingdon, No. 2 engine failed to respond to throttle inputs. The aeroplane struck cables and trees 18 minutes after lifting off. Of 17 passengers and five crew aboard, all but four were killed in the accident.

zh.s: 1957年3月5日，英国皇家空军第53中队一架编号XH117的布莱克本“贝弗利”C Mk 1重型运输机，在伯克郡德雷顿的萨顿威克坠毁。飞机起飞后，1号发动机出于预防被关闭；返回阿宾登空军基地最后进近时，2号发动机又不响应油门操作。起飞18分钟后，飞机撞上电缆和树木。机上17名乘客及5名机组人员中，只有4人生还。

en.s: On March 5, 1963, country music stars Patsy Cline, Cowboy Copas, and Hawkshaw Hawkins were killed in a plane crash near Camden, Tennessee, United States, along with the pilot Randy Hughes. The accident occurred as the three artists were returning home to Nashville, Tennessee, after performing in Kansas City, Missouri. Shortly after takeoff from a refueling stop, the pilot lost control of the small Piper PA-24 Comanche while flying in low visibility conditions, and subsequently crashed into a wooded area, leaving no survivors. Investigators concluded that the crash was caused by the non-instrument rated pilot's decision to operate under visual flight rules (VFR) in instrument meteorological conditions (IMC).

zh.s: 1963年3月5日，美国乡村歌手帕齐·克莱恩、牛仔科帕斯和霍克肖·霍金斯，与飞行员兰迪·休斯，在田纳西州卡姆登附近坠机身亡。三位艺人刚在密苏里州堪萨斯城演出，正返回田纳西州纳什维尔。小型派珀PA-24“科曼奇”飞机在加油经停后起飞不久，于低能见度下失控，坠入林区，无人生还。调查认定，飞行员没有仪表飞行资格，却选择在必须依靠仪表的天气中按目视飞行规则驾驶，导致事故。

On 5 March 1963, the Ilyushin Il-18 crashed while landing at Ashgabat International Airport as a result of a dust storm. 12 of the 54 people on board were killed.

zh.s: 苏联民航191号班机是从莫斯科伏努科沃国际机场飞往阿什哈巴德国际机场的苏联国内客运航班，中途停靠克拉斯诺沃茨克机场（今土库曼巴希国际机场）。1963年3月5日，一架伊尔-18客机在阿什哈巴德机场降落时遭遇沙尘暴并坠毁。机上54人中有12人遇难。

en.s: The March Intifada (Arabic: انتفاضة مارس‎‎) was an uprising that broke out in Bahrain in March 1965. The uprising was led by Leftist groups, the National Liberation Front - Bahrain calling for the end of the British presence in Bahrain and numerous notable individuals participated in the uprising, including Wa'ad political activist Ali Rabea. The uprising was sparked by the laying-off of hundreds of Bahraini workers at the Bahrain Petroleum Company on March 5, 1965. Several people died in the sometimes violent clashes between protesters and police.

en.s: BOAC Flight 911 was a round-the-world flight operated by the British Overseas Airways Corporation (BOAC) that crashed near Mount Fuji in Japan on 5 March 1966, with the loss of all 113 passengers and 11 crew members. The Boeing 707 flying the route disintegrated mid-air shortly after departing from Tokyo Haneda Airport as a result of severe clear-air turbulence.

zh.s: 1966年3月5日，英国海外航空运营的环球航班911号，在日本富士山附近坠毁，113名乘客及11名机组人员全部遇难。执飞的波音707从东京羽田机场起飞后不久，遭遇严重晴空湍流，在空中解体。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 5 March 1967, with a second round on 12 March, electing the third National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. en.s: Lake Central Airlines Flight 527 was a regularly scheduled Convair 580 flight on March 5, 1967, from Chicago, Illinois to Detroit, Michigan with stops at Lafayette, Indiana, Cincinnati, Ohio, Columbus, Ohio and Toledo, Ohio. The aircraft crashed near Marseilles, Ohio, killing all 38 passengers and crew on board. This remains the deadliest aviation accident in the state of Ohio.

zh.t: 湖中央航空527号班机空难
zh.s: 1967年3月5日，湖中央航空527号定期航班由康维尔580执飞，从伊利诺伊州芝加哥飞往密歇根州底特律，沿途经停印第安纳州拉斐特，以及俄亥俄州辛辛那提、哥伦布和托莱多。飞机在俄亥俄州马赛附近坠毁，机上38名乘客及机组人员全部遇难。原文称，这仍是俄亥俄州死亡人数最多的航空事故。

en.t: Air France Flight 212 crashes in Guadeloupe
en.s: On March 5, 1968, local time, Air France Flight 212 crashed while approaching Le Raizet Airport in Pointe-à-Pitre, Guadeloupe. All 63 people aboard the Boeing 707 were killed. The flight was traveling from Santiago to Paris with intermediate stops.

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in West Germany on 5 March 1969. The incumbent President, Heinrich Lübke had served two terms and was therefore ineligible for a third. The Christian Democratic Union nominated defense minister Gerhard Schröder. Schröder was a controversial choice, even within his own party, since he had been a member of the NSDAP and the SA under Hitler. Other potential candidates included Helmut Kohl and Richard von Weizsäcker, relatively unknown names at the time, who would go on to serve as Chancellor and President respectively. Justice Minister Gustav Heinemann was nominated by the Social Democratic Party and supported by the opposition Free Democratic Party.

en.s: The 1969 Urban Council Election was held on 5 March 1969 for the 5 of the 10 elected seats of the Urban Council of Hong Kong. 8,166 of 34,237 registered voters voted, the turnout rate was 23.8% Peter Chan Chi-kwan of the Civic Association was newly elected to the Urban Council.

en.t: The Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty enters into force
en.s: The Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons entered into force on 5 March 1970, after the depositary governments and forty other states deposited their instruments of ratification. The treaty aims to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons and technology, promote peaceful uses of nuclear energy, and advance nuclear disarmament.

en.s: The 1972 African Cup of Nations final was a football match that took place on 5 March 1972, at the Stade Omnisports in Yaoundé, Cameroon, to determine the winner of the 1972 African Cup of Nations. Congo defeated Mali 3–2 with two goals from M'Bono and a goal from M'Pelé, against one goal from Diakhité and another from M. Traoré to win their first African Cup.

zh.s: 1972年非洲国家杯决赛于3月5日在喀麦隆雅温得的综合体育场举行。刚果以3比2击败马里，首次夺得非洲杯。姆博诺攻入两球，姆佩莱攻入一球；马里由迪亚基特和M.特拉奥雷各进一球。

en.t: Iberia Flight 504 and Spantax Flight 400 collide over Nantes
en.s: On 5 March 1973, Iberia Flight 504, a DC-9 carrying 68 people, collided with Spantax Flight 400, a Convair 990, near La Planche in Loire-Atlantique, France. The DC-9 crashed, killing everyone aboard; the damaged Convair landed at Cognac.
en.n: The Convair landed after the collision; it did not crash with the DC-9.

zh.t: 伊比利亚504号与斯潘塔克斯400号航班在南特附近相撞
zh.s: 1973年3月5日，载有68人的伊比利亚504号航班（DC-9客机）与斯潘塔克斯400号航班（康维尔990客机）在法国卢瓦尔-大西洋省拉普朗什附近相撞。DC-9坠毁，机上人员全部遇难；严重受损的康维尔990随后在科尼亚克降落。
zh.n: 康维尔990在相撞后降落，并未与DC-9一同坠毁。

en.s: The 1975 Hong Kong Urban Council election was held on 5 March 1975 for six of the 12 elected seats of the Urban Council of Hong Kong. 10,903 eligible voters cast their votes, higher than any previous election, though still less than a third of registered voters, less than five per cent of those eligible ratepayers, civil servants, professionals and other professions and a much tinier proportion still of the adult population.

en.s: The 28th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from 22 February to 5 March 1978. en.s: Thebe (), also known as Jupiter XIV, is the fourth of Jupiter's moons by distance from the planet. It was discovered by Stephen P. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Benin on 5 March 2006.
